name: ruflo-ruvector
description: Self-learning vector database via npx ruvector@0.3.13 — HNSW, adaptive LoRA embeddings, code-graph clustering, exact min-cut, RaBitQ/DiskANN extras, hooks routing, brain/SONA, 118 MCP tools. As a mod (ADR-445): a write guard that keeps secrets out of the vector store and shared brain, /ruvector-mod, and a status file the console shows

guard.title: Secret guard
guard.description: Refuse calls to this plugin's write tools that hold a key, token or password.
